title: 第3章 不服一拳打飞第4章 小妹郑萱的危机
slug: 和女帝双修后我出剑即无敌
lines: 郑元一步步逼近了王艳，眼睛里闪过一道寒光。
“王艳，我的未婚妻，你没想到吧？小爷我还活着呢。”
当初自己为了她不惜一切代价，修炼资源都给了她，九死一生弄回了龙云果，结果却被她一掌打下了万丈深渊。
王艳刚才的惊慌失措瞬间恢复了平静，紧接着露出一丝讥笑：“郑元，当初本姑娘接近你就是为了获取修炼资源，可惜你这个傻子还对本姑娘舔得不行，怎么，现在骨气硬了？”
王艳看到郑元身上露出的开脉一层境界大声取笑着。
可叹这个傻子还真以为自己真心喜欢他。
如今自己比他还高了一个大境界，没啥害怕的。
当初要不是为了利用他为自己提升修为，改善根骨，怎么会答应那桩婚约。
啪啪！
郑元突然一巴掌呼了过去：“贱人，这第一巴掌是替我自己打的，第二巴掌是替云飞哥打的。”
啊！
“郑元，本姑娘要杀了你！”
王艳感受到脸上一片火辣简直要气疯了。
自己如今已经是浩城的天之骄女，居然被一个傻子给打了耳光，简直就是奇耻大辱。
呼！
王艳身形一晃，一掌狠狠拍了出去，既然郑元不识抬举，那自己就让他再死一次。
一股强大无比的真气轰然而出，周围众人也不禁大惊失色。
这要是被打中了，郑元恐怕不死也要重伤。
毕竟开脉二层修为要比开脉一层修为强大的多。
至于刚才郑元打了王艳两巴掌，众人都认为是侥幸罢了。
啪！
这次王艳彻底呆住了，自己居然又被扇了一个耳光，连对方一个衣服角都没有碰到。
郑元嘴角露出一丝讥笑，手里拿着那张婚约，突然用力一撕。
“今日你我恩断义绝，从此犹如路人！”
一道响亮的声音传遍了四面八方，撕碎的婚约更是如同一只只飞舞蝴蝶四散而飞。
“放肆！”
就在下一刻突然一道身影从王家人群中走了出来。
一身华服锦衣，身形笔直，手里拿着描金扇，三角眼里闪过一道寒光。
“龙少爷，他欺负我，你可要给我做主啊。”
王艳看到出来的人立刻跑了过去，抱着被称为龙少的人胳膊，哭的稀里哗啦。
这一刻周围众人都有所明悟了，为什么王艳要退婚，为什么要暗算郑元，原来是攀上高枝了。
“王小姐别急，本少一定会为你出气的。”
龙少轻轻拍了拍王艳的柔荑安慰道，一脸深情。
“龙少，打断他的腿。”
王艳一脸恶毒的指着对面的郑元狠狠地说道。
“放心吧，美人。”
龙少把王艳轻轻推开，一步迈了出去：“小子，本公子龙啸天，红云宗弟子，你今天欺负了本少的女人，赶紧跪地求饶，磕三个响头，打自己十巴掌，否则小心你的狗命。”
刚才事情发生的太突然了，龙啸天也来不及救王艳。
当时可心疼坏了，王艳这女人床上功夫太好了。
让人欲罢不能，欲仙欲死，爽到极点，而且还是自己的女人，打她就是不给自己面子。
一股强大无比气势从龙啸天身上涌了出来，开脉三层修为。
周围众人听到这话瞬间都惊呆了，浩城三大家族就够牛了，这位居然是红云宗弟子，还是开脉三层修为。
content_en:
Zheng Yuan approached Wang Yan step by step, a cold light flashed in his eyes.
"Wang Yan, you didn't expect my fiancée, did you? I'm still alive, young master."
Back then, he spared no effort for her, gave her all his cultivation resources, and managed to get back the Longyun Fruit after a narrow escape, but in the end, he was knocked down into the abyss by her palm.
Wang Yan regained her composure from the panic just now, and then revealed a trace of sneer: "Zheng Yuan, when I approached you, I was just to obtain cultivation resources. It's a pity that you, a fool, still can't lick me. Why, now you have a strong backbone?"
Wang Yan laughed loudly when she saw Zheng Yuan's first-level pulse-opening state.
It's a pity that this fool really thinks that he really likes him.
Now that I am at a higher level than him, I have nothing to be afraid of.
If it wasn't for the purpose of using him to improve his cultivation and improve his bones, why would he have agreed to that engagement?
Bang bang!
Zheng Yuan suddenly slapped him and said, "Bitch, this first slap is for myself, and the second slap is for Brother Yunfei."
Ah!
"Zheng Yuan, this girl is going to kill you!"
Wang Yan felt the heat on her face and almost went crazy.
Now that she is the proud daughter of Haocheng, to be slapped by a fool is simply a great shame and humiliation.
call!
Wang Yan's body swayed, and she slapped him away with a palm. Since Zheng Yuan didn't know how to appreciate others, she would let him die again.
An extremely powerful zhenqi burst out, and everyone around him couldn't help but be shocked.
If he were hit, Zheng Yuan would probably be seriously injured even if he didn't die.
After all, the second-level cultivation of opening meridians is much more powerful than the first-level cultivation of opening meridians.
As for Zheng Yuan's two slaps to Wang Yan just now, everyone thought it was just a fluke.
Snap!
This time Wang Yan was completely stunned. She was slapped again, without even touching a corner of the opponent's clothes.
A trace of sarcasm appeared on Zheng Yuan's lips. He held the engagement contract in his hand and suddenly tore it up with force.
"Today you and I have severed all ties, and from now on we are just like passers-by!"
A loud sound spread in all directions, and the torn engagement contracts were scattered like flying butterflies.
"Presumptuous!"
At the next moment, a figure suddenly walked out from the crowd of Wang family.
He was dressed in rich clothes, with an upright figure, holding a gold-painted fan in his hand, and a cold light flashed in his triangular eyes.
"Master Long, he bullies me, you have to make the decision for me."
When Wang Yan saw the person coming out, she immediately ran over, hugged the arm of the man named Long Shao, and burst into tears.
At this moment, everyone around them realized why Wang Yan wanted to break off the engagement and why she wanted to plot against Zheng Yuan. It turned out that she was climbing a high tree.
"Don't worry, Miss Wang, I will definitely vent my anger on you."
Mr. Long gently patted Wang Yan's catkin and comforted her with an affectionate look on his face.
"Master Long, break his legs."
Wang Yan pointed at Zheng Yuan opposite and said harshly with a vicious look on her face.
"Don't worry, beauty."
Young Master Long gently pushed Wang Yan away and took a step forward: "Boy, my young master, Long Xiaotian, is a disciple of the Hongyun Sect. You bullied my young woman today. Kneel down and beg for mercy. Kowtow three times and slap yourself ten times. Otherwise, you will be doomed."
What happened just now was so sudden that Long Xiaotian had no time to save Wang Yan.
I felt really distressed at the time, because this woman Wang Yan was so good in bed.
It makes people want to stop, it makes them want to die, it feels so good, and she is still his woman, so beating her is not giving him face.
Huh...
An extremely powerful aura surged out of Long Xiaotian, opening up the third level of cultivation.
Everyone around was stunned when they heard this. The three major families in Haocheng were already impressive. This person was actually a disciple of the Hongyun Sect, and he was still at the third level of Kai Mai.
